## Description and Rationale

We are two old friends, both working at the forefront of AI and Data Science at major financial firms. With a passion for aviation, data and AI, the challenge offers an interesting opportunity to explore all 3 spaces with a defined end goal.

## Details

* Type: Independent
* Country: United Kingdom
* Number of team members: 2
